content.text:
I wrote this list from memory and didn't open any of the links, so please spot-check them before relying on them. Each one is either an official engineering post or the company's own open-source repository.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the HTTP proxy that handles much of its edge traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service, rewritten from Go for latency", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "Core of the file sync engine", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, plus S3, EC2 and Lambda components", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, including Windows components", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform system components", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Source control backend (Mononoke, Sapling) and other internal tools", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2021/04/29/developer-tools/rust/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Stylo, the CSS engine in Firefox", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer syncing server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy, the service-mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "npm", "use": "Authorization service on the registry's critical path", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "YJIT, the Ruby JIT compiler", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/ruby-yjit-is-the-fastest-ruby-yet"},
  {"company": "Datadog", "use": "Vector observability data pipeline", "source": "https://github.com/vectordotdev/vector"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot/Substrate blockchain stack", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs", "use": "Solana blockchain validator", "source": "https://github.com/solana-labs/solana"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet WebAssembly compiler/runtime for Compute@Edge", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Symbolicator, which handles native crash symbolication", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/symbolicator"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB 3 (IOx) time-series database", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Rack-scale server control plane and firmware", "source": "https://github.com/oxidecomputer/omicron"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and libraries", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "Mullvad VPN", "use": "VPN client app", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Signal", "use": "libsignal, the core cryptographic library", "source": "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "Ruff linter and uv Python package manager", "source": "https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff"},
  {"company": "Hugging Face", "use": "Tokenizers library", "source": "https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://github.com/denoland/deno"},
  {"company": "Brave", "use": "adblock-rust, the browser ad and tracker blocking engine", "source": "https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed code editor", "source": "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed"},
  {"company": "Prisma", "use": "Query engine behind the Prisma ORM", "source": "https://github.com/prisma/prisma-engines"}
]
```

For the entries that link to a repo, the repo shows the company ships Rust, but it isn't a statement from the company. The Shopify and Microsoft entries are the least direct. The Shopify post is about YJIT, which is written in Rust. The Microsoft post is a general case for Rust rather than a list of what they ship.
